expectations: every case's divergence decomposes into isomer_branching / quasi_stable_convention / other; 'other' is quantified, never assumed zero
'other' >1% of arm total on >5% of cases forces the nuclide/path into named open classes
scoped claim reports measured medians/maxima per response; no unmeasured equivalence
isomer_branching expected dominant under IRDFF at shutdown (~11% on Mn-58m1 sampled); deviations are findings
census bounded to 184 cases; arm failures recorded not skipped

classes.isomer_branching: ALARA metastable label (mN suffix) absent from ACTINV emission
classes.quasi_stable_convention: ALARA idx half-life finite but >1e15 s
classes.other: all remaining divergence incl. ACTINV-only nuclides and common-nuclide magnitude gaps
